question: The average age of 25 students of a class is 33 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 34 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Teacher's age = Old average + Extra per person contribution

⇒ Increase in average = 34 − 33 = 1

⇒ Extra total = 1 × 26 = 26

⇒ Teacher's age = 33 + 26 = 59

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 25 students = 33 years.

New average including teacher = 34 years.

Total number of individuals = 26.

**Formula used:**

Age of teacher = (New average × Total individuals) − (Previous average × Number of students).

 25 Students Avg = 33 Teacher Age = ? Group Avg = 34 
• 
• 

**Calculations:**

Total age of students = 25 × 33 = 825 years.

⇒ Total age including teacher = 26 × 34 = 884 years.

⇒ Age of teacher = 884 − 825 = 59 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 59 years (Option 4).**
